articleTitle: Realization of BCI System based on SSVEP for Disabled Elederly
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the development of elderly care service and management, the digital products are more and more widely used in the elderly. This paper designed and realized the Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) System of a wheelchair for the disabled elederly. The wheelchair can be controled by the eyes and can drive and turn round, so it can liberate the feet of the elderly. The BCI system is based on the Steady-State Visually Evoked Potentials (SSVEP) and realized on the platform of OMAP3530, it mainly includes the visual stimulus module, the EEG signal acquisition module, the bridge forwarding module, the data processing module, the control module and the wheelchair. This paper designed and selected four frequency to initiate the relative evoked potentials in cerebral cortex, and then does the feature extraction and feature calssfication through the algorithm of Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA), finally to control the wheelchair. The system can get accuracy of ninety percent with the sliding windows, and the man-machine interaction time is controlled within two seconds, it can meet the actual needs completely.

articleTitle: Design of Hole Depth and Wireline Drill Pipe Fault Detector
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problems of hole depth detection and wireline drill pipe fault point detection in coal mine underground drilling construction, in order to quickly detect and verify the depth of a single borehole and detect the fault type and fault point position of wireline drill pipe, an integrated coal mine hole depth and wireline drill pipe fault detector is designed, which can solve these two problems at the same time. The structure design and the application mode applied to the construction of conventional rotary drilling and horizontal directional drilling, and the application effect and future development direction of the instrument in the field test are analyzed.

articleTitle: Establishment and Verification of Core Loss Model of Nanocrystalline under Square Wave Excitation
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Accurate estimation of core loss plays an important role in the design and optimization of medium and high frequency transformers. The traditional loss calculation formula is usually applied to calculate core loss under sinusoidal excitation. However, the high-frequency transformer usually works under the non-sinusoidal excitation. In order to improve the accuracy of core loss calculation, the traditional loss calculation formula is modified and optimized in this paper. Furthermore, considering the generality of loss formula at different characteristic frequencies, the nonlinearity of coefficient in loss formula is further investigated, and the relationship between model coefficient and frequency is proposed. Finally, the optimized loss model is verified with experimental results, which is proved to be feasible in estimation of nanocrystalline core loss under square wave excitations.

articleTitle: Study on Deformation of Steel Cylinder Machine Structure in Wave Loads
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Taking the large-diameter thin-walled steel cylinder enclosure structure of the Hong Kong Macao Zhuhai Bridge as the research object, using the ABAQUS numerical simulation method, establishing a three-dimensional elastic finite element model of steel cylinders, the steel cylinder structure, and the surroundings are a sticky foundation, using the ABAQUS the user material subroutine UMAT interface is provided, and the most widely used Hardin-Drnevich equivalent linear viscoelastic model is used for the viscous land base dynamic constitutive model. Based on the ABAQUS finite element platform, the simulated wave loop load is used to simplify the regular double-phase simple harmonic analog wavy cycle load. The structural effects of steel cylindrical thin-walled structures, and studied the power response of steel cylinders in the adhesive base basis by changing the amplitude of the steel cylinders on the position of the sea level and the magnitude of the wavy load. The dynamic response of steel cylinder embedded in clay foundation is studied, such as displacement and rotation angle of steel cylinder. The research shows that the wave cyclic load has an important influence on the protective structure of large-diameter thin-walled steel cylinder located in clay foundation. Under different wave loads, the displacement and corners of the steel cylinders have a certain degree of change, and along with the sea level position change, the deformation of the steel cylinder also exhibits a certain change.

articleTitle: Research on Crashworthiness Design and Qualification Technology of Civil Aircraft Fuselage Fuel Feed Line
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The fuel feed line in the fuselage of civil aircraft does not produce fuel leakage and cause fire is very important for the survival of passengers in the aircraft crash. This paper focus on the crashworthiness design qualification of fuel line in the fuselage of civil aircraft to provide the safety of aircraft and the survival rate of passengers in the case of crash. And the airworthiness regulations related to the crashworthiness of aircraft fuel system, the crashworthiness design characteristics of fuel feed line in fuselage, and the fuel feed hose are analysed and qualification test are discussed. Usually, the guillotine test to qualify the hose crashworthiness ability. The method, rig, installation are also studied, and shown that recommended hose can meet the requirements of crashworthiness regulation after guillotine test.

articleTitle: Influence of Speed Index on Small Damping Ratio Vibration Isolation System
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The effect of the speed index of the dampers on the vibration isolation performance of the system was analysed by the method of equivalent damping. The analysis found that for the force excitation system, the use of damping with speed index greater than 1 is beneficial to improve the vibration isolation performance of the system for high-frequency vibration, and the use of damping with speed index less than 1 will reduce the vibration isolation performance of the system for high-frequency vibration. For the displacement excitation system, using damping with speed index greater than 1 will reduce the vibration isolation absorption of the system for high frequency, and when using damping with speed index less than 1, it will improve the vibration isolation performance of the system for high frequency. This shows that the damping ratio is no longer constant for vibration isolation systems with nonlinear damping, and changes with the change of frequency ratio. For the study of small damping ratio vibration isolation system, the method of equivalent damping is simpler and more convenient, and it is easy to get the vibration isolation performance of the system in each frequency.

articleTitle: Application of Sensor Network Technology in Internet of Things Architecture of Intelligent Machinery Manufacturing
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: At the present stage, the concept of intelligent manufacturing is highly respected in China, and it is also the main direction leading the development of manufacturing industry. This paper is for intelligent machinery manufacturing Internet of things architecture application of sensing network technology research. It analyzes the new era of sensing background of intelligent Internet of things technology application situation, summarizes the ship based on sensing network of intelligent machinery manufacturing Internet of things technology type, summarizes relevant experience, hopes to provide scientific development advice for workers in the same industry.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Project Based on Best-Worst-Method and Vague Set Techniques
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The construction and implementation of electric vehicle charging station (EVCS) project can effectively alleviate environmental pollution problems. However, the EVCS project has the characteristics of large investment and long franchise period. At the same time, it also involves multiple project participants, complex relationship and many potential risk factors. This paper first identifies the potential risk factors of EVCS project, establishes the EVCS project risk evaluation index system including 12 secondary indicators from the four dimensions of policy, technical, market and construction and operation, and then develops the project risk evaluation model based on best-worst-method (BWM) and Vague set techniques. Finally, taking an EVCS project in a region as an example, this paper makes an empirical analysis to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model, which can improve the risk prevention level and response ability of investors.

articleTitle: A new optimal design method of glass fiber leaf spring
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the lightweight and performance requirements of glass fiber leaf spring of a light commercial vehicle, a multi-objective optimization design method based on new particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the problems of global extreme selection, global convergence and local search ability of standard multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, the inertia weight factor is introduced to improve the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the optimal election method and the comprehensive compromise election method based on linear weight discrimination are introduced to the objective function, which greatly improves its performance; finally, taking the relevant parameters of glass fiber leaf spring as the design variables and taking the strength, stiffness and quality of glass fiber leaf spring as the sub objectives, an optimization model is established to optimize the original design; finally, the effectiveness of the optimization method is verified by finite element simulation and sample test. The simulation and test results show that the optimized glass fiber leaf spring reduces the mass and meets the requirements of the whole vehicle for the stiffness and strength of the leaf spring.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of double helical star gear system considering wind resistance excitation
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The wind resistance moment of a single pair of double helical star gear system with different tooth clearance is analysed based on the RNG k-epsilon turbulence model and dynamic mesh. The results show that the tooth surface wind resistance moment calculated by the two models is not much different; The fluid dynamics model of the double helical star gear system under oil lubrication conditions is built, the characteristic tooth wind resistance torque is calculated, and the results show that the characteristic tooth wind resistance torque has obvious fluctuations; the wind resistance excitation of the gear system is introduced and the dynamic response of the system is solved, the results show that the wind resistance caused by lubrication change the dynamic characteristics of the system, which performance better.

articleTitle: Research on on-line monitoring technology of characteristic gas in vacuum on-load tap-changer oil
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Breakdowns of vacuum on-load tap changer (OLTC) occur frequently in recent years, which have seriously affected the safe and stable operation of the electric power system. Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) is an effective method to diagnosis the latent faults of vacuum OLTC.However, the current periodic test mode not only aggravates the burden of operation and maintenance personnel, but also makes it difficult to detect the possible internal hidden dangers of the vacuum OLTC in time. In this paper, on the basis of analyzing the failure cases of vacuum OLTCs and the DGA data of multiple vacuum OLTCs in operation, it is concluded that acetylene is the main characteristic gas that reflects the operating status of vacuum OLTC. Then this paper proposes a vacuum OLTC acetylene on-line monitoring device based on the combination of membrane degassing and laser photoacoustic spectroscopy (PAS) detection technology, and introduces the main technology and performance indicators of the device. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the vacuum OLTC acetylene online monitoring device through the actual case of on-site test operation.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation validation of RBC Movement Authority functions for the column control system
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: RBC (Radio Block Center) is the key equipment for CTCS-3 Train Control System to control the safe operation of the train. It is responsible for communication with on-board equipment and providing movement authorization for the train, so as to realize the operation control of the train. Whether RBCs can generate the correct MA (Movement Authority) is the key to ensure that trains can operate safely. Based on the technical specification of infinite block center and the theory of timed automata, this paper models, simulates and verifies the process of RBC Movement Authority generation. The validation results indicate that the MA model established in this paper meets the functional requirements and safety requirements of the technical specifications and provides a theoretical reference for further improving the design and development of RBC systems.

articleTitle: Research on interactive trading mechanism of adjustable load aggregators
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the proposal of the "double carbon" goal, the power industry carries out the construction of new power system, and a large number of new energy units are put into operation, which brings great uncertainty to the power supply and puts forward higher requirements for the regulation capacity of generator units. The power balance and safe and stable operation of traditional power system are facing great challenges. The power consumption of real economy accounts for a large proportion in the power grid load. Through the research on the load characteristics of the main body of the real economy, it is found that there are a large number of adjustable and transferable loads. Measures such as flexible transformation and electricity price incentive can be taken to make it play an important role in the new power system, realize the transformation of power supply and demand balance from "source with load" to "source load interaction", and provide support for the business model innovation of the real economy. At the same time, the state has gradually introduced relevant policies to encourage adjustable load aggregators to participate in the power market. The adjustable load aggregator connects the aggregated resources through advanced information and communication technology and software system, and participates in the power market and power grid operation as a special power plant. For the scenario of adjustable load aggregators participating in the power market, this paper studies the corresponding interactive trading mechanism, analyzes the characteristics of adjustable load aggregators and the distribution of benefits from participating in the market, and finally assumes an interactive trading mechanism suitable for adjustable load aggregators and the trading varieties that adjustable load aggregators can participate in the market, By designing the interactive trading mechanism participated by adjustable load aggregators, we can lay a foundation for the further participation of adjustable facility resources in the power market in the future, improve the utilization rate of load adjustable facilities, and promote the consumption of new energy under the new power system.

articleTitle: Study on the smoke particles distribution characteristics of a certain tear gas bomb
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Tear gas bomb adopts aerosol form to achieve stimulating effect on living targets, and its smoke particles distribution directly affects its combat effectiveness. Therefore, in order to provide theoretical support for the performance evaluation of a certain tear gas bomb, based on the measurement of the particle cumulative distribution and particle size of the sample smoke by the laser particle size analyzer, this paper researches the cumulative distribution of the smoke particle size, its variation regular with the particle size, and its growth changes situation with particle size, and so on. The results show that the particle size of the sample is less than 50micrometer and is suitable; and its distribution uniform and consistent is very excellent, 92.45% of the particles are distributed in the range of 4-28micrometer; the cumulative distribution of the aerosol smoke particle size presents the increasing gradient with the change of particle size, and it is mainly divided into 4 stages; the cumulative distribution of particle size increasing extent is biggest when the particle size is during 4~24 micrometer. The above results indicate that the smoke particles of a certain tear gas bomb have excellent distribution characteristics, which establishes a good foundation for its operational effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Airworthiness Technical Requirements and Compliance Verification Method of Induction System Icing Protection of Transport Aircraft
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: There are potential safety impacts on the intake system of transport aircraft engine working under the condition of freezing of supercooled large water droplets. FAA has put forward airworthiness requirements for engine operation under the condition of freezing of supercooled large water droplets through amendment 25.1309(b). This paper analyzes the airworthiness of the revised provisions. From the compliance design analysis of two dimensions of engine uninstalled state and installed state, combining with the experience model, respectively from the nacelle, power plant and the body part of the compliance of the corresponding advice is given to demonstrate the thinking and method, to carry out domestic transportation aircraft engine supercooled large droplets anti-icing airworthiness compliance work to provide technical support.

articleTitle: Virtual inertial control considering SOC equalization
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the amount of new energy power generation has gradually increased, and the DC power grid has become more widely used. In order to ensure the stable operation of the DC grid, the voltage control strategy has received extensive attention. Based on traditional droop control, this paper considers the balance of state of charge（SOC） between virtual inertia and energy storage units, and innovatively proposes virtual inertia control considering SOC equalization. By adding a correction factor, the droop coefficient is continuously changed to maintain the voltage stability of the DC grid.

articleTitle: Construction of waste heat recovery system for precision forging
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper calculates the heat consumption of Baicheng Zhongyi Precision Forging Co., Ltd. in winter. The heating heat consumption of the enterprise is about 4300kW. At the same time, after investigation, it is concluded that the enterprise generates a large amount of heat energy in the production process, and finally wastes the heat energy into the environment in the form of direct emission, causing high-temperature pollution to the surrounding environment. Combined with the current situation that the utilization rate of forging waste heat of the enterprise is 0%, three schemes are proposed, namely, direct waste heat recovery system, steam turbine generator waste heat recovery system and waste heat recovery system. After analysis, the waste heat recovery system is better than the other two schemes in terms of energy conversion, function realization and cost. Therefore, this paper constructs the precision forging waste heat recovery system, and the precision forging waste heat recovery subsystem provides 25% of the heat energy for the heating system. In order to improve the service life of the system, impurity filter and analytical deaerator are designed to improve the quality of water used in the system.

articleTitle: A Processing equipment for organic water of Slaughterhouse Based on hydraulic cavitation effect
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the expansion of slaughterhouse scale, a large amount of production wastewater is brought, which contains a large amount of organic matter and virus. Direct discharge will cause serious impact on the environment. And the existing slaughterhouse wastewater treatment equipment cannot deal with the increasing discharge of wastewater. Based on the high efficiency of hydraulic cavitation for sterilization and inactivation, the project improved the traditional slaughterhouse sewage treatment process. This equipment makes it not only for sewage blood and other pollution treatment, but also for sterilization and other operations, so that the discharge of water to meet the national discharge standards.

articleTitle: Study on the adaptability of PM and NOx cleaning technology for construction machinery
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The pollutant emission of non-road construction machinery has gradually attracted attention. The paper selected typical non-road construction machineries to install the after-treatment device. The technology route of after-treatment device was selected based on the basic technical parameters and operating conditions of machinery. The paper studied on adaptability of after-treatment technology, and the result shows: the appropriate emission control technology can effectively reduce the pollution of machineries, with the reduction rate of particulate matter more than 90% and the reduction rate of NOx more than 65%.

articleTitle: Brief Introduction on Technology and Process of Intermediate-Water Reuse
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Water is an important natural resource for our survival and development. In recent years, the problem of water shortage has become more and more serious. Many developed countries have long been committed to opening up second water sources, such as seawater desalination, reclaimed water reuse and so on. In this paper, the main advanced of intermediate-water reuse technologies such as physicochemical method, biological treatment, and membrane bioreactor process, and reclaimed water reuse treatment process such as cloth media filter, V-shaped filter, variable pore filter, biological aerated filter, high density pool, ultrafiltration system, counter-infiltration system are introduced, aiming to provide technical support for the long-term stable operation of circulating water system in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of civil aircraft tank deformation on fuel consumption curves
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The fuel consumption curve of civil aircraft has an important impact on the design of the aircraft and the flight safety. The center of gravity of the civil aircraft changes continuously with the fuel consumption during the flight. This paper analyzes the effect of a civil aircraft fuel tank deformation on the fuel consumption curves, and analyzes the changes in the fuel consumption curve and changes in fuel curve on the center of gravity of aircraft based on different fuel tank deformation.

articleTitle: Rigid-flexible coupling and acoustic-vibration coupling analysis of high-speed double helical planetary gear system
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to obtain the vibration and noise characteristics of the high-speed double helical planetary gear system, a rigid-flexible coupling dynamic model is established, and the dynamic response of the nodes on the surface of the gearbox is calculated. The peak value of the vibration acceleration frequency response at the evaluation points mainly occurs at the rotation frequency, meshing frequency and its frequency multiplication. An acoustic-vibration coupling model including structural mesh, acoustic mesh and field point mesh is established, the radiated noise on the surface of the gearbox and the field points is calculated by using indirect acoustic finite method. The maximum value of the sound pressure on the surface of the gearbox and the sound pressure of the field points appeared at the position of the input shaft, and the peak value of the radiated noise at each field points mainly occur near the rotation frequency of the gear pair and its meshing frequency.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Planning of Robot Armfor Hair Washing Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Hair-washing is a common thing in people's daily life, but due to the longer hair, most women have difficulties in the washing process. And for the elderly and some disabled people, washing hair is also a relatively difficult task. With the continuous development of science and technology, hair-washing robots have gradually been used in the society, which has solved the problem of groups with difficulties in hair-washing to a large extent. Among them, the trajectory planning for hair-washing with robotic arm plays an extremely important role in ensuring the washing effect and comfort. This paper focuses on the robots for hair-washing with robotic arms, and analyzes its activity rules.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Fuel System Pipe Icing of Transport Aircraft
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Based on traditional jet fuel system icing test conformance verification of inadequate understanding, focus on the fuel line of may affect the normal function of fuel accumulation amount of risk on the wall of the instantaneous loss of ice, so the need for aircraft fuel system pipeline freezing test to determine accumulated in the pipe line and the maximum number of ice fall off. Through the research and analysis of the influencing factors of pipeline icing, the main influencing factors of aircraft fuel system pipeline icing test are pointed out. These influencing factors can confirm the critical value through the test, which can be used as the input of the test to confirm the maximum amount of pipeline icing.

articleTitle: Study on practicability of escalator / moving walk safety assessment method
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The escalator / moving walk safety assessment is complicated, involving interested parties such as user management, maintenance company, and has no less than 100 single risk projects. The single risk project results will also be used repeatedly, which test the patience of the safety assessors. In order to solve these problems, this paper studies the practicability of escalator / moving walk safety assessment. First, the preliminary work of escalator / moving walk safety assessment is combed. Then the determination method of single risk category is described, the safety assessment of the whole machine is got according to the results of single risk projects. According the above method, the human-computer interface of safety assessment is provided, so as to make escalator / moving walk safety assessment more practical. An escalator safety assessment case is given and the practicability of the safety assessment is confirmed.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Welding Robot Workstation Based on RobotStudio
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of the intelligent manufacturing industry, welding robot workstations have been widely used in the forming and manufacturing of industrial products. In this paper, a new type of welding robot workstation composed of robot and positioner is designed. First, the forward kinematics analysis of the welding robot is carried out by using the kinematics method; Second, a robot workstation system is built based on RobotStudio to create tools and other mechanical devices, and program the workstation offline; Finally, the simulation of the designed workstation is set to carry out virtual motion simulation. The simulation results show that the welding robot workstation designed in this paper can effectively solve the problems that the end effector cannot be reached and the position and posture are incorrect when a single robot welds complex and large workpieces, which effectively improves the welding quality.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Vanadium and Titanium Auto Parts Industry in Panzhihua City
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Vanadium titanium auto parts are unique products in Panzhihua. How to better develop this advantage and promote the development and economic construction of Panzhihua Vanadium-titanium auto parts industry has become the key issue in the future. Panzhihua vanadium-titanium auto parts industry is facing a difficult external environment, which is highlighted by the fact that manufacturers still adopt traditional design methods to develop vanadium-titanium auto parts products, resulting in low design efficiency and low product qualification rate. The paper mainly aims at the development of vanadium-titanium auto parts industry in Panzhihua city, and puts forward corresponding countermeasures. By using the digital design method, it can realize the design and analysis of automobile parts in computer and improve the design efficiency and pass rate. Product data management is adopted in the product development of vanadium titanium auto parts. Manage product information in the computer, establish a common working environment, and shorten the design cycle. Combining the internet with computer information technology, the marketing countermeasures of vanadium and titanium auto parts industry in Panzhihua city are studied. By implementing the above scheme, the design and development level of auto parts can be improved, and the development and economic construction of vanadium and titanium auto parts industry in Panzhihua city can be promoted.

articleTitle: Prediction of EV Charging Load Combination Based on Grey Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The analysis and prediction of EV charging load state are directly related to subsequent charging planning and power consumption management, so it is of great significance to carry out EV load analysis and research. Firstly, grey correlation analysis was used to calculate the similarity between the predicted date and the historical date. Thus, the best similarity date was obtained by orderly arrangement, and the multi-correlation date scene set was established. Then, based on the similar day data, a prediction model was established using a support vector machine algorithm. Considering the prediction deficiency of the single model, a prediction model based on the time series algorithm was established to predict EV charging load according to the data of the first few days of the predicted day. The combined prediction method based on weight is proposed to comprehensively consider the complementary advantages of the two prediction models to improve the accuracy and stability of load prediction. Finally, the actual load of electric vehicles in Chongqing is predicted to verify the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on PID control of potato stable seed supply based on repetitive control compensation and CMAC
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In view of the complex working environment of the air-suction potato planter, the conventional PID controller is difficult to achieve stable seed supply for potatoes due to its slow response, weak anti-interference, and large overshoot. Combining the advantages of repetitive control compensation and CMAC, this paper designs a PID control strategy for stable potato seed supply based on repetitive control compensation and CMAC, which is used to realize the stable seed supply of potato. The simulation results show that the composite PID control method improves the response speed of the system, improves the tracking accuracy of the system, and enhances the anti-interference ability of the system compared with the CMAC and the conventional PID parallel control method.

articleTitle: Research on Image Restoration of Ancient Buildings Based on Deep Convolution Network
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Handicraft repair has appeared hundreds of years ago. Through this technology, people can repair damaged art products and make the repaired items meet the visual requirements of human beings as much as possible. Image restoration technology, as a technology related to handicraft restoration, has been paid attention to by many people in recent years. Digital image restoration is an important research direction in the field of computer vision. In recent years, with the excellent performance of deep learning in image processing, more and more research teams begin to use the relevant methods of deep learning to deal with the problem of image restoration. Image restoration technology is an efficient image tampering technology. This tampering method will not leave obvious traces, which brings severe challenges to forensics. Image restoration passive forensics technology judges the authenticity and integrity of the image by detecting the extracted image features. In view of the remarkable achievements of deep neural network in automatically finding the features needed for classification. The vision system can quickly find the object of interest in the picture and send it back to the brain for further processing. Introducing the attention mechanism of the vision system into the computer can greatly improve the performance of the computer. Saliency calculation in visual mechanism can provide the fast computing ability to locate the prominent foreground, exclude the background, and accurately complete various image analysis tasks, which is widely used in various computer vision tasks.

articleTitle: Research on time synchronization sliding mode control algorithm of light weapon target
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Taking a domestic light weapon test target as an example, the test target is fast, and each instrument needs synchronization accuracy within hundreds of nanoseconds to meet the test requirements. A set of accurate time synchronization system is designed to provide a unified time benchmark for the test system. Based on IEEE 1588 protocol, the consistency of data acquisition timing of test equipment at each node is guaranteed, and the synchronization of PTP protocol has the disadvantages of asymmetry. The sliding mode control algorithm is used for optimization. The experimental results show that the synchronization accuracy of normal PTP and PTP with sliding mode control is 38ns and 107ns respectively.

articleTitle: Innovative design of light-weight extruded wallboard extraction and ferrule device
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Lightweight extruded wall panels have become an important part of the energy-saving development of prefabricated buildings. In order to improve the productivity of lightweight extruded wall panels to meet their use requirements in the building construction process,the innovative improvement of the light-weight extruded wallboard extraction and ferrule system is proposed.Based on the analysis of the workflow of the extraction and ferrule system of lightweight extruded wall panels, completed the design of the positioning structure of the light extruded wall panel extraction and ferrule system, ensured that the device operates according to the intended route. Layered vertical collection is realized by L-shaped guide groove, the horizontal device adds a positioning card board to complete the mobile automation. Through the finite element analysis of the base beam, the feasibility and effectiveness of the innovative design of the light-weight extruded wall panel extraction and ferrule system are verified.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of ESC Hydraulic Actuator Unit
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the performance of ESC hydraulic actuator unit, the booster valve of ESC hydraulic actuator unit is simulated in this paper. Based on ANSYS, the simulation analysis model of booster valve is established by using finite element method, and the electromagnetic field distribution characteristics of booster valve are analyzed. At the same time, the analysis of the electromagnetic force characteristics of the booster valve provides a data basis for the optimization design of the booster valve.

articleTitle: Innovative design of automatic mold cleaning system for PC component production line
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The automatic mold cleaning system of PC components is an important link to realize the development of digital manufacturing and prefabricated building. Establish the mold driving system, the three synergistic relationship models of PC component production line, complete the motion parameter design of the automatic mold cleaning system of PC component production line, by using the electric wire rolling brush and high pressure nozzle cleaning method to complete the mold automatic cleaning system of PC component production line innovation design. Based on the finite element analysis of the support beam, the feasibility and effectiveness of the overall innovative design of the automatic mold-cleaning system are verified.

articleTitle: An Introduction of Pedal Cleaning Device for Automatic Sidewalk
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper designs an automatic sidewalk pedal cleaning device to clean up the impurities in the sidewalk pedal groove. A plurality of vertical grooves are arranged on the pedal of the automatic sidewalk, and comb plates matching these grooves are arranged at both ends of the automatic sidewalk, which can clean the grooves to a certain extent. However, considering the safety performance, the comb teeth of the comb plate will not contact the bottom of the groove, so additional tools are needed to clean the groove of the automatic sidewalk. However, the cleaning tools used in the prior art have the technical problems of slow cleaning speed and unable to collect the cleaned garbage. The device comprises a frame, a scraper installed in the front space of the frame, an aggregate cavity inserted in the square hole at the rear of the frame, a bottom support fixed on both sides of the frame and a push rod respectively connected with the bottom support. Compared with the prior art, the device has the advantages of good cleaning effect, fast and efficient operation, reducing environmental pollution, safe operation, etc.

articleTitle: Milling Cutter Wear Prediction Based on Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Neural Networks
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The wear of milling cutters during high-speed milling processes affects the quality of the work-piece, productivity and manufacturing costs. Accurate tool wear prediction can therefore optimize production decisions and avoid losses due to tool wear. To improve the prediction precision, this paper proposes a method for predicting the wear of milling cutters based on bidirectional long short-term memory neural networks and attention mechanism. By extracting the time domain features, frequency domain features and time-frequency domain features based on time series data generated during industrial processes and using bidirectional long short-term memory neural networks to learn the complex mapping relationship between the extracted features and the wear amount. Experimental results show that this method reduces mean square error by 70.81% and 47.97% compared to the SVR model and the BPNN model respectively, and reduces mean square error by 79.69% and mean absolute percentage error by 5.977% compared to the CNN, enables a more accurate and reliable milling cutter wear prediction.

articleTitle: Research on space path planning algorithm of robot based on improved RRT
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order that solves the poor efficiency of motion planning of manipulators in multi-dimensional space, a novel path planning algorithm is proposed, which mixes the potential field and improved random extended tree method. Firstly, based on the standard random extended tree algorithm, a step size selection strategy is leveraged to enable the expansion point to quickly cross the non-threatening area and enter the potential field constraint, so the search speed is accelerated. Secondly, sampling constraints and growth forbidden zone are set to keep the expansion point away from the threat quickly and effectively when the expansion point enters into the range of the potential field. Then, the greedy strategy and cubic B-spline curve are conjoined to smooth the path. Finally, the improved algorithm is simulated in two environments with different complexity. The results show that the improved algorithm can significantly improve the running time and path optimization under the different environments.

articleTitle: An Introduction of Replaceable Elevator Guide Shoe Structure
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Guide shoe is an important component of elevator. It can fix the car on the guide rail so that the car can only move up and down. There is also an oil cup on the upper part of the guide shoe, which is mainly used to reduce the friction between the shoe lining and the guide rail. Each elevator car is equipped with four sets of guide shoes, which are installed on both sides of the upper beam and under the safety gear seat at the bottom of the car, and four sets of counterweight guide shoes are installed at the bottom and upper part of the counterweight beam. The guide shoe fixed on the car can move back and forth along the fixed guide rail installed on the wall of the building shaft to prevent the car from deflecting or swinging during operation. Among them, the sliding friction method is adopted between the nylon block and the guide rail, so the nylon block is an easily worn part. Over time, the gap between the nylon block and the guide rail will increase and need to be replaced. Because the elevator guide shoe used now is an integrated design, the design between the nylon block and the fixed support is inseparable. Therefore, the nylon block cannot be replaced separately inside the elevator, but it is troublesome if the whole guide shoe is removed for replacement. This paper studies a kind of elevator guide shoe with fast replacement speed and low cost.

articleTitle: Simulation of Axial Fan in Subway based on CFD
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: To give guidance and direction for the design of subway axial fan, optimize design project, shorten design period and reduce manpower and material resources that the design experimentation should consumed. Physical model and mathematical model were established by use commercial computational fluid dynamics software FLUENT. The physical model was segmented by tetrahedron unstructured network. Then the boundary condition was settled according to real condition. At last pressure field and velocity field under different rotate speed were simulated of the subway axial fan. Then the total pressure and efficiency was obtained and result of simulation was contrasted with tested results. Wind volume and pressure are so inosculated and very same under rated condition. Then the numerical simulation result is reliable and can guide the subway axial fan design.

articleTitle: Simulation and characteristic analysis of pressure closed-loop control of servo direct drive pump-controlled hydraulic system based on AMESim
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the working principle of servo direct drive pump-controlled hydraulic system, the mathematical model of pressure closed-loop control system is deduced, and the simulation model of pressure closed-loop control circuit is built in AMESim. The characteristics of pressure open-loop and closed-loop of servo direct drive pump-controlled hydraulic system and the important parameters that affect the pressure closed-loop PID control characteristics, such as hydraulic cylinder leakage coefficient and PID parameters, are simulated and analyzed. The simulation results show that the dynamic performance of the pressure closed-loop control system of servo direct drive pump-controlled hydraulic system can be improved significantly by selecting the reasonable control parameters.

articleTitle: Research on the Positioning Design of Fixtures in Machining
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The main function of the so-called fixture positioning is to ensure the effective contact between the workpiece datum surface and the fixture positioning element, thereby realizing a comprehensive restriction on the degree of freedom of the workpiece, so as to process mechanical products. Due to the prominent importance of this work, this paper discusses the positioning design of fixtures in machining, expounds the specific design process and methods, and looks forward to the future development of fixture positioning design for reference.

articleTitle: Research and typical application of microgrid transaction method based on blockchain
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: At present, the distributed transaction scheduling of microgrids has many problems, such as high implementation costs and inability to operate independently, which leads to differences in distributed power transaction requirements and cannot fully meet the needs of new energy that cannot be fully absorbed. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a blockchain-based microgrid transaction design plan, establishes a transaction process method, and selects the park microgrid as a case to verify the function. Through actual case analysis, the correlation law between decentralization, reliability and operating efficiency and operating cost is obtained, and the proposed strategy is verified through the operating data of the microgrid in the park.

articleTitle: Research on test frame for elevator door
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Elevator door system is an important part of the whole elevator. Too large blocking force and kinetic energy of the closing elevator door will cause direct impact injury to passengers. The closing stopping force of elevator landing door and car door shall not exceed 150N when measured after 1/3 of the closing trip. And the closing stroke kinetic energy of elevator landing door and car door shall not exceed 10J at the average speed. At present, there is no special scientific instrument to measure these data, and it is generally difficult to measure and verify them. Traditional method using spring scale hook may lead to several human affect factors, unscientific measurement methods and poor repeatability of measurement results. The traditional elevator door test frame is also inconvenient for installation and the result may be affected by the driving mechanism exposed. This article researches a new test frame for elevator door, which contains base, under frame, side support, slide chute, door panel, install plate, install slot, clamping force test mechanism, top frame, device mounting box, bolt, positioning frame, extension rod, inspection rack, detection slot, pressure sensor, install frame and display panel. This test frame can realize facilitate installation and disassembly of elevator door and avoid the influence to elevator door caused by the exposure of the line. This method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of elevator door detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Marine Diesel Engine Propulsion Shafting Condition
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The marine diesel engine propulsion shafting is not only an important part of the turbine, but also an important guarantee for the safety and normal navigation of the ship. With the development of large-scale, high-efficiency, and intelligent ships, not only the size and quality of the spiral awards have increased ingeniously, but the deformation of the hull structure has increased significantly, and the shafting structure, function, and state are all changing, which attracts more attention, and affected by factors as loading conditions, sea conditions in the sailing area, maintenance and repair, etc., it may cause erratic changes in the propulsion shafting state of the ship's diesel engine, excessive wear of the tail bearing, and even serious mechanical damage accidents such as shafting fatigue and breakage, which endanger the safety of the ship. And normal sailing. Therefore, from the perspective of the whole life cycle, it is necessary to deeply understand and master the service performance and service status changes of the large-scale "reciprocating and rotating" power system composed of the "diesel engine, one shaft, one spiral award".

articleTitle: Prediction of Spatio-temporal Distribution of Electric Vehicle Load based on Data-driven
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The spatio-temporal distribution prediction of electric vehicles (EVs) charging load is the prerequisite and basis for analyzing the interaction between EVs and power grid. In order to improve the current deficiencies, which includes subjective parameter settings and user behavior analysis that is out of reality in the process of load forecasting, we use probability statistics to establish an analysis model for the charging behavior of different vehicle types, urban areas, and typical days. It bases on the actual data of the charging piles in Chongqing. Monte Carlo prediction model based on instantaneous charging probability is used to simulate the spatio-temporal distribution prediction of charging load. The results of comprehensive and regional load analysis are obtained, and the comparative analysis proves that the results of the regional forecasting method are more accurate. The vehicle charging behavior data fitting formula and load forecasting results in this article can provide a reliable basis for the construction of electric vehicle charging facilities and the optimal dispatching strategy of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Test Method of Small Arms Based on Distributed Network
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In the traditional full ballistic test of light weapons, there are problems that the equipment is isolated and the data is not benchmarked at a unified time. This paper studies the integrated test method of light weapons based on distributed network. The hardware framework and software structure of the integrated test platform are expounded. A comprehensive integrated platform for the full ballistic test and performance test of light weapons is established, and the integration of the test equipment of each node of the full ballistic under the control of the unified bus is realized. It has been proved by practice that the collaborative testing capability of each distributed node equipment in the full ballistic test of light weapons has been effectively improved, and the test data can be analyzed comprehensively and effectively under a unified time benchmark.

articleTitle: Development of special series tools for power transmission overhaul
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and efficiency of power transmission overhaul, a series of tools are developed according to the problems found in the operation process. In the operation of grounding wire in power transmission overhaul, the existing grounding insulation Rod is limited by tower type and operation position, and the operation is complicated, the safety and working efficiency of the grounding wire are improved. Transmission work can not be separated from highaltitude transmission tools, the traditional transmission mode has certain operational risks or limitations, this paper introduces a fall-proof steering device, to solve the above-mentioned shortcomings. It is difficult to fix the distance of the existing insulated operating pole in the maintenance of live line work, which limits the working position of the operators. The utility model provides an adjustable distance insulating operating Rod, which increases the operation convenience. On the basis of analyzing that there is no special pulling-out tool for the R type spring pin of the new type equipment, a special pulling-out device for the R type spring pin is developed to fill this gap. This paper presents a series of special tools for transmission maintenance to reduce the difficulty of work, improve the efficiency of work, so as to improve the safety of people, power grid and equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Waste Heat Recovery of Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Two-stroke marine diesel engines are widely used in the ships all over the world because of their high efficiency and reliability. Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) system is adopted by the main engine manufactory for the purpose of decreasing the NOx emission in marine diesel engines. However, the fuel economy of the diesel engine is poor due to the poor burning efficiency in the cylinder and additional power consume of the EGR auxiliary device. For the purpose of increasing the fuel economy of the diesel engine, the recovery of the waste heat of the recirculation gas is studied.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of cruise diesel engine system
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The reliability analysis of cruise diesel engine system has significant practical significance. However, due to the complex structure of the system and the variety of subsystems and components, there are a variety of derived fault modes, and each fault mode has its own characteristics, so it is difficult to achieve a unified evaluation. Therefore, FMECA analysis method was used to divide the system structure and evaluate each fault mode quantitatively. At the same time, for the diesel engine system, combined with Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, comprehensive quantification of the system fault hidden danger grade. So as to provide some reference for the actual operation and maintenance of cruise ship, reduce the difficulty and cost of actual operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Omni-directional Adaptive Stable Platform Technology
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper will analyze and study an omni-directional adaptive stabilization platform technology, which has been expected to solve the yaw problem of the one-dimensional azimuth antenna base of the balloon-borne suspended radar by using the effect of gravity. This stable platform can keep the azimuth axis of the one-dimensional azimuth antenna base always vertical to the earth without servo control and drive. The stable platform can well meet the stability requirements of a certain balloon-borne suspended antenna, and has a good application prospect in similar fields.

articleTitle: Research on Steering Control Method of New Energy Vehicle under Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the development of modern big data analysis technology and machine learning algorithm, massive real user data can better manage the steering control of new energy vehicles. By mining massive real data of new energy vehicles and obtaining vehicle driving behavior patterns, it is helpful to conduct more in-depth and accurate research on the management algorithm of new energy vehicles. In this paper, the experimental sample of four-wheel independent traction/steering all-electric vehicle is taken as the research platform, and the special variable Angle transmission ratio of the steering system is designed. The relationship between the variable Angle transmission curve and the performance of the steering motor is analyzed. The influence of the curve on the performance of the motor is improved by means of parameter optimization. The coordination and synchronization of four steering motors in the steering system is studied. The simulation results show that the improved T-function can improve the stability of vehicle steering and prolong the service life of motor.

articleTitle: Analysis of Technical Standards of Indian Mining Explosion-Proof Diesel Engine Vehicles
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the technical standards of explosion-proof diesel engine vehicles in India. It focuses on the research on the technical requirements of the standard frame, the overall structure of the vehicle, the explosion-proof diesel engine, the braking and electrical system, and the safety protection system, and expounds the application status of mining explosion- proof vehicle in India. The analysis shows that the technical standards for explosion-proof diesel vehicles in India have a comprehensive and systematic structure, and the requirements for various technical indicators are mature. When Chinese mining explosion-proof diesel vehicles are exported to India, the relevant manufacturers should master the relevant technical standards in advance so that they can successfully obtain the Indian DGMS approval.

articleTitle: Research on stability of rotor-bearing system based on DOE method
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper deals the stability of the rotor-bearing system (RBS) with the Design of Experiment (DOE) method. Firstly, the amplitude attenuation of the RBS under free vibration is analysed. Then, the minimum modal damping ratio (MMDR) is selected to characterize the stability of the RBS. Furthermore, based on the DOE method, the Main Effects Plot, the Pareto Plot and the Interaction Plot under different parameter value ranges are established and discussed. The results show that there are obvious interaction effects between the bearing parameters, and the optimal value of the RBS can be obtained.

articleTitle: Experimental Comparison Study of Airborne HFC-125 and Halon 1301 Fire Extinguishing System
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: All new aircraft apply for type certification to EASA after 2014 must deploy non-Halon fire extinguishing system. In this paper, a test study of the discharge performance of the HFC-125 fire extinguishing system is carried out to compare it with the Halon 1301 fire extinguishing system. The analysis of the test data shows that the Halon1301 fire extinguishing system has a significantly higher flow rate than the HFC-125 fire extinguishing system for the same system design. And the fill pressure of the system affects Halon1301 system more than HFC-125 system. Therefore, the HFC-125 fire extinguishing system must be modified based on the original Halon1301 pipeline system. Furthermore, the concentration distribution of the extinguishing agent shows that both agents have very good dispersion properties. Moreover, the different charging pressures have a small effect on the diffusion of the extinguishing agent.

articleTitle: Research on the Thermo-Kinetics Mechanism of CH4/DME High Pressure Premixed Combustion in Air/CO2 Atmosphere
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Through the analysis of fuel composition and oxidant atmosphere, the premixed combustion characteristics of gas turbine are studied, and the application of binary fuel mixed with DME and CH4 in power system is explored. This paper research on the problems of CH4/DME in premixed combustion of gas turbine, including: the calculation of experimental data mostly focuses on the combustion stability, flame characteristics and pollutant emission under atmospheric pressure. Through CH4/DME premixed Air/CO2 high pressure combustion, the experiment of thermochemistry and reaction kinetics mechanism is established, and the numerical simulation research is established to deeply explore the combustion performance, combustion emission and their balance relationship of premixed combustion. It provides a further theoretical basis for the high-pressure combustion of non-standard fuels in industry.

articleTitle: Design of industrial inspection system based on GPU
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Industrial inspection is an indispensable part of Industrial production automation. In the era of the Internet of Things, machine vision is the main method of industrial inspection. Machine vision is mainly composed of image acquisition module, image processing module and image display module. The graphics processing unit (GPU) can convert the serial structure with low data dependency into a parallel structure. This article will proposes a design for the inspection of printed circuit boards (PCB). This design based on GPU will solve the problem of long inspection times. Through the parallel design of several industrial detection algorithms, and compare the time of the serial structure with the time of the parallel structure, the advantage of the parallel structure to the industrial detection algorithm is highlighted.

articleTitle: Mechanical Structure Design and Mechanical Analysis of Variable Diameter Expansion Cone Block
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: On basis of structural design, a calculation model with mechanical and movement was set up, and the functional relationships of expandable force with thrust, wedge angle, friction coefficient and thrust with binding force, friction coefficient were obtained. Calculation results showed that expandable force was 1.53 times of the thrust, the thrust increased 8.8kN when friction coefficient increased from 0.1 to 0.4, the thrust increased 19kN when friction coefficient increased from 0.5 to 0.8, maximum stress was 454 MPa.

articleTitle: Fatigue Life Analysis of Oil Buffer Used in Circuit Breaker Operating Mechanism in Action Process
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to obtain the fatigue life change of the oil buffer for the operating mechanism of the circuit breaker during the operation process, static calculation was carried out at the critical moment of the oil buffer operation process, and the fatigue life of the cylinder block was analyzed from the SN curve. The result found that: During the operation of the device, the maximum stress and strain points generally appear near the edge of the oil discharge orifice. The actual maximum stress is about 300MPa, and the strain is basically at the um level; the maximum stress point is always coming when the cylinder has the maximum pressure. At the moment, the most vulnerable position of the oil buffer is near the edge of the oil discharge orifice, but its cycle life is still far beyond the national standard.

articleTitle: Study on weight and centre of gravity limit of jacking operation under different wind speed of civil jet aircraft
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The aircraft needs to be in a steady state when jacking up on the ground, if the plane is outside, we must consider the impact of the wind on its stability, formulate the weight and center of gravity limit under different wind speed. Through calculation and analysis, considering the aerodynamic parameters, overall aircraft parameters, fuselage wing jacking position, weight and gravity limit and load limit of the plane, and obtain the limit of jacking operation under different wind speed, draw the weight and center of gravity limit at different wind speed to provide operator guidance.

articleTitle: Research on vibrations induced by work roll bearings on temper mill
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The vibration speed of a temper mill was tested by using a vibration online monitoring system, and the vibration characteristics and rules were obtained. With the help of ADAMS, a model simulation study was carried out on the the clearance fit between work roll bearing and the roll neck. It was found that the larger the fit clearance and the higher the rotational speed, the more serious the vibration of the roll system. By applying the sweeping excitation to the model, the inherent frequency of the temper mill model is found out. When the excitation frequency generated by the work roll bearing reaches 320Hz, it will cause the obvious vibration phenomenon of the roll system, resulting in vibration marks on the surface of the strip and the backup roll. To this end, the corresponding vibration suppression measures are proposed, and good vibration suppression results are achieved.

articleTitle: Development and Application of a High Temperature Wired Measurement While Drilling System
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: More deep directional wells will be drilled to meet the word’s increasing demands for oil and gas. In order to measure the wellbore trajectory parameters (inclination, azimuth and tool face angle) during direction drilling in deep wells, a high temperature wired MWD system was developed. This MWD system includes surface subsystem and downhole subsystem, and the two subsystems are connected by armored cable. Field test shows that, the temperature resistance of the wired MWD exceeds 260 ℃ for over 8 hours. The field application results validate the accuracy and reliability of the wired MWD in wells with depth up to 8000m.

articleTitle: Analysis for a crack of the manhole in a reactor of Ethidene Diamine unit
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: A crack of the manhole were found in the D-2310 main reactor of an Ethidene Diamine unit in a chemical company during quality acceptance of installation. The methods of macroscopic examination, chemical composition analysis, hardness test, metallographic examination and fracture analysis were used to analyze the cause of the crack. The results showed that too high welding temperature, non-uniform welding line energy and unstable electrode quality were the main reasons for the welding heat crack. The repair measures of this crack were suggested at last, which can be used as a reference to prevent the welding heat crack in manufacturing processes.

articleTitle: Research on IMA Common Mode Analysis for Powerplant System in aircraft
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: According to the requirement of CCAR25.1309 (b), the system design must provide fail-safe capability to prevent single failure propagation in order to prevent catastrophic condition. Moreover, the common mode failure that influences single part and fail-safe conditions are not allowed. Common Cause Analysis is the compliance method used in CCAR25.1309 (b), and Common Mode Analysis is part of Common Cause Analysis. Common Cause Analysis is used to check the independence of function/system meet the requirement. The critical function implemented with redundant components, channels and IMA devices is easily influenced by common design error. The independence between components is hard to prove and belongs to single failure category. The independence between components needs to be analyzed through Common Mode Analysis. The Common Mode Analysis of SWITCH and GPM is studied. In the analysis, loss of IMA single component, erroneous IMA single component and the similar IMA components all erroneous are analyzed. This research supports the closure of CCAR25.1309 (b).

articleTitle: The flexibility of thermal power unit under the background of the new power system
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The construction of the new power system significantly increases the difficulty of the space-time balance of power supply in the power system. The system needs to increase the flexible adjustment capacity, the flexibility of thermal power unit transformation was particularly important. It was necessary to carry out a comprehensive study on the technical path and comprehensive evaluation of the flexible transformation of thermal power units. It was urgent to consider the effectiveness of thermal power flexibility transformation investment from the perspective of power system as a whole, reduce the overall cost of thermal power flexibility transformation, and form a thermal power flexibility transformation model with the best overall system.

articleTitle: Fatigue Evaluation Direct Method of Gearbox Housing Base on Hilbert-Huang Transformation
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: A direct method of fatigue evaluation based on practical test data was studied, Hilbert-Huang Transformation (HHT) method was used to transform random vibration signal obtained from the running test of Electric-Multiple-Unit(EMU), and retained the key effective vibration acceleration signals to be used as a load source to drive fatigue calculation of simulation model of gearbox housing. Firstly, the running test data of 2000 seconds was intercepted, HHT transform the test data in the range of 0~1000Hz to obtain the effective vibration spectrum in time-frequency domain; Secondly, modal frequency response analysis has been done to verify that the topical frequency of vibration stress of gearbox housing; Thirdly, calculated the housing stress by inertia release load method to obtain base calculation model for housing fatigue calculation, and used the effective vibration signals extracted by HHT as the load input to drive the base calculation model, convert the number of fatigue cycles according to the mileage in 2000 seconds, and complete the fatigue calculation of housing. Finally, compared the housing's equivalent stress obtained by actual EMU running test with the damage value obtained by the direct evaluation method, and verified the effectiveness and accuracy of direct evaluation method based on the comparison results.

articleTitle: Research on verification strategy of civil aircraft airborne electronic hardware
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In the airborne electronic hardware (AEH) certification, the manufacturers often use different verification strategies, which make it difficult to fully show compliance to RTCA/DO-254 during certification. This paper make a thorough analysis and comparison of verification methods commonly used in certification, comprehensively considering various factors such as safety, design complexity, cost, program schedule, etc.. This paper proposes a AEH verification strategy based on different design assurance level (DAL). This strategy has been used in the certification of civil aircraft AEH, and has been gradually accepted by certification authority and industry.

articleTitle: Study on vibration of underground powerhouse of a large-scale hydropower station
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Hydropower is an important clean energy with the largest capacity in China. Due to the influence of various vibration source loads, the vibration of the powerhouse is one of the important problems affecting the operation of the hydropower station. In this paper, the comprehensive study on vibration problems was conducted based on a large-scale underground powerhouse structure. Firstly, the vibration test points were arranged in the underground powerhouse, then the vibration intensity variation with unit load was obtained from large amount of vibration displacement data. In the other hand, the dominant frequency distribution was analyzed to explore the characteristics of the vibration source, and also the component proportions were derived based on wavelet decomposition and reconstruction to quantify the degree of contribution of different vibration source for the vibration of the powerhouse structure. The field test results showed that: (1) The vibration of the tested powerhouse structure is generally in a relatively safe state. The vibration in vertical direction is significantly greater than the vibration in horizontal direction. (2) The vibration intensity gradually decreases with the unit load increasing. (3) The tail water pulsation is the main sources of the vibration. which has a significant contribution more than 90% to the vertical vibration. This study can provide guidance for further research on the vibration of underground powerhouse structure of hydropower station.

articleTitle: Experimental research on follow-up control of lower limb exoskeleton robot
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This paper designs a motor-driven exoskeleton robot for lower limbs. According to the mechanical structure of the lower limb exoskeleton robot, the hardware and software systems of the robot were designed, and the dynamics model of the exoskeleton was constructed. And a follow-up control strategy based on minimizing human-computer interaction force was proposed. The parameters Kp and Kd in PD controller are determined by a lot of experiments and engineering setting method. The experimental results show that when the follow-up control mode is turned on, the designed followup control strategy has a good effect, and effectively reduces the human-computer interaction force.

articleTitle: Simulation of water hammer characteristics of liquid rocket engine
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Taking the liquid rocket engine as the research object, the modeling and simulation study of its propellant filling process is carried out. The finite element state space method is used to model the propellant supply pipeline, and the influence of pipeline size parameters and initial pressure on the water hammer phenomenon in the filling process is simulated. The results show that during the propellant filling process, shortening the length of the pipeline, selecting an appropriate pipeline diameter, and reducing the initial pressure can effectively suppress water hammer.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation via User Cooperation for Uplink NOMA-MEC Systems
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The fifth-generation mobile communication has strict requirements on spectrum resources.
