In view of the low spectrum utilization and the poor user fairness of the existing non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) systems, this paper studies the resource allocation problem in multi access edge computing (MEC) based on uplink cooperative NOMA. In particularly, we assume that the user can be regarded as Full-duplex (FD) relay equipped with transmitting antenna and receiving antenna to help other users offloading data to the base station (BS). In this study, the computation offloading problem is deduced under the constraints of transmission power and computing resources and establishes the resource allocation problem among users to minimize the system computational overhead. Because the optimization problem is nonconvex, the improved differential evolution (DE) algorithm is used to solve the optimal power allocation efficiently. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can significantly reduce the total computational overhead of the system compared with the traditional scheme.

articleTitle: Welding process test and application of white copper tubes and steel tubesheet
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Based on the welding characteristics analysis of the Cu-Ni alloy tubes and the low alloy steel tubesheet in the seawater cooler of a platform, the method of gas tungsten arc welding is adopted, and the welding procedure measures and parameters are worked out. The macroscopic inspection, dimension inspection, nondestructive inspection, mechanical properties and metallographic inspection were carried out on the welding procedure qualification samples. The results show that the welding method, procedure measures and parameters formulated can satisfy the practical production. The success of the welding procedure qualification is of great significance to the manufacture of the seawater coolers.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation and Analysis of Nature Frequency of Cylindrical Linear Motor Stator
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Cylindrical linear motors have broad application prospects in the fields of rail transportation, precision medicine, and vertical lifting. At the same time, these occasions require the motor to run smoothly with low noise. Therefore, it is of key significance to analyze the vibration characteristics of the motor, the stator of the new type cylindrical linear motor is composed of multi-layer cylindrical shells, and its vibration characteristics can be obtained by equivalent simplification processing of thin-walled cylindrical shells. This paper constructs the corresponding analysis model for calculation the natural frequency of a thin-walled cylindrical shells. Based on the analytical model, influence of important parameter such as length, wall thickness, and mid-plane diameter of cylindrical linear motor on its vibration characteristics is studied. The relevant analysis and calculation methods and conclusions are verified by finite element simulation, which can provide reference for subsequent design of cylindrical linear motors.

articleTitle: Defect Identification of PCB Board Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: With the development of semiconductor manufacturing technology, PCB industry also faces the challenge of quality problem. In this paper, aiming at the defect object of PCB board, by comparing the effect of various operators on image pretreatment, the appropriate processing operator is selected. And the algorithms of image feature extraction, recognition and matching are studied, and the intelligent detection method based on machine vision is studied. In addition, the cross-correlation image registration algorithm is used to calculate the deviation between the reference image and the first registration image through the cross-correlation function. Simulation results show that the algorithm has good registration effect and high precision in PCB defect detection.

articleTitle: Innovative design of automatic cutting system for lightweight wall panels
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The intelligent production of lightweight wall panels is a necessary support for promoting the industrialization of prefabricated buildings. In view of the problems of low efficiency and poor precision in the production process, an innovative improvement of the automatic cutting system for lightweight wall panels is proposed. The automatic cutting system of lightweight wall panels is optimized by combining a synchronous moving device and a clamping device to ensure that the cutting device moves synchronously with the lightweight wall panels. Aiming at the accuracy of the synchronous moving device of the lightweight wallboard cutting system, the optimization measures of the control system structure of the cutting device are proposed to realize the fixed-length cutting of the wallboard, and one reciprocating motion can cut the wallboard twice. The feasibility and effectiveness of the innovative design of the lightweight wallboard cutting system are verified by the finite element analysis of the clamping clip.

articleTitle: A torque detection device for Electric Actuator based on OrangePi
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: As an important device in industrial automation system, Electric Actuator is widely used in modern industrial control. For the actual demand of specific working conditions, it needs to output a certain torque. At present, the factory torque calibration of Electric Actuator is basically calibrated by control box. This paper presents a solution of visual interface based on OrangePi. The scheme is based on the simulated resistance of Magnetic Powder Brake, the detection torque of torque sensor and the detection speed of encoder. The OrangePi is used as the control core, and the output current of KTC800A tension controller controls the resistance; HMI interface is designed based on lightweight display framework lvgl, which is simple and intuitive; This scheme detects the detailed operating parameters such as current, voltage, speed and torque of the Electric Actuator during operation, and uploads various parameters to Alibaba cloud Internet of Things platform. Users can view data remotely through web pages. The torque test of bare metal and whole machine of Electric Actuator is realized.

articleTitle: Simulation of the leakage magnetic field of ultra-high-voltage autotransformers based on finite element method
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Based on the technical parameters and the structural characteristics of the 1000 kV ultra-high-voltage (UHV) transformer, the magnetic leakage distribution of the UHV transformer with and without magnetic shielding is studied using ANSYS Maxwell. The difference of magnetic flux leakage distribution of UHV Transformer under two conditions is analyzed, and the change of magnetic shielding on magnetic flux leakage distribution is discussed. The relevant conclusions provide a reference for the maintenance and the research on magnetic flux leakage of the UHV transformer.

articleTitle: Design of a new type of fast oil spill recovery deformation ship based on smart suction port
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The marine oil spill accident not only wastes a lot of resources, but also causes irreversible damage to the marine environment. In this paper, a new oil spill recovery variant unmanned ship based on the intelligent suction port is designed for the oil spill accident. By using the new oil film The intelligent suction port of the thickness monitoring method is used to conduct preliminary separation of oil spills at sea, thereby greatly improving the efficiency of oil spill recovery. Hold other than this, the design of the variant ship allows the unmanned ship to adapt to the sea and its harsh environment to ensure oil spill recovery efficiency.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Crutches for the Elderly
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In response to the global trend of population aging, the existing crutches in the market are upgraded and integrated according to the travel needs and characteristics of the contemporary elderly, and thus a multi-functional crutch for the elderly is designed, and its design scheme is introduced to achieve a multi-purpose crutch in this paper. The old-aid crutches integrate lighting, keys, medicine storage, cushions, umbrellas, and fall alarm devices. This design responds to the new concept of “smart elderly care”, actively copes with the population aging, and improves the elderly care service system from the perspective of assisting the elderly, which helps to meet the growing needs of the people for a better life.

articleTitle: Research on Used Car Valuation Based on Gradient Descent Multiple Regression Model
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: Due to the particularity of "one car, one situation" of used cars, there is always the problem of non-standard pricing in transactions. We comprehensively consider various factors affecting the price of used cars and propose a gradient descent multiple regression algorithm to solve the problem of used car valuation. By preprocessing the 30000 sample data collected from C market of used car trading, analyzing and extracting the influencing factors affecting the sales price of used cars, and then gradient reducing each factor to obtain a reasonable used valuation model. Finally, using the trained model, we can complete the price estimation of used cars in the new sample.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the airfoil
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: The numerical simulation of different wing models at zero angle of attack was investigated. This simulation uses Python to build a model, and constructs the shape of sine function, cosine function, quadratic function and cubic function respectively. Different shape functions were found to significantly influence the subsequent flow field. Furthermore, the areas near the surface of the airfoil show more disturbances of X- and Y-velocities. NumPy and Matplotlib package were used to calculate the velocity on X-axis and Y-axis and display the results in graph.

articleTitle: An Improved Optimization Method Based on Multi-row Facility Layout Problem
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to meet particular process requirement, rework stations are delimited in workshops. However, diversity and volatility of rework production can lead to a huge amount of rework transportation cost which needs to be optimized. An optimization model of workshop layouts based on rework rate was proposed in this paper. Firstly, an objective function of the minimum total cost of logistics was established, which was composed of production transportation cost and rework transportation cost. After comprehensive analysis, the relations of transportation flows between each procedure and rework areas were quantified. Then various constraints were established according to actual conditions in workshops. In addition, with a randomly generated initial population, a genetic algorithm was applied to search for the optimal workshop layout. Finally, a case study was demonstrated to show how the proposed model worked. Compared with the huge amount of rework logistics cost in traditional workshop layouts, this new model solved the problem effectively. This model turned out to be valuable for production lines with high rework rate or multiple rework procedures.

articleTitle: Visual Modeling and Analysis of Jamming Effect of Electronic Countermeasures Equipment Based on STK
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to quantitatively analyze the effect of satellite communication jamming to find the best jamming solution, based on the STK platform, this article visually modeled the electromagnetic environment of the battlefield and the jamming effect of electronic countermeasures equipment. Finally, the jamming effect was measured from the two aspects of the bit error rate and signal-to-interference ratio of satellite communications jamming. The verification results of a specific scenario are given by simulation. During the simulation process, the battlefield situation data is displayed on the STK platform in real time. In particular, the real-time visualization of the jamming effect evaluation data can provide deduction data for the proposed electronic countermeasure plan, and provide strong support for commanders to command operations and make strategic decisions.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation for pressure and speed double closed-loop of servo direct drive pump-controlled hydraulic system based on AMESim
publicationTitle: ISMSEE 2022; The 2nd International Symposium on Mechanical Systems and Electronic Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problems of pressure and flow overshoot and lag in hydraulic system, the simulation model of the system was established by AMESim based on the working principle analysis of speed-pressure hydraulic circuit of servo motor, the closed-loop control strategy of speed-pressure feedback PID of servo motor was proposed, and the simulation analysis was carried out. The Simulation results showed the PID closed-loop control strategy can realize the pressure priority control, and can accurately control the pressure and flow with the changes of the target pressure and the target speed.
